# Dr. Saumika Singh — Oculoplasty, Orbit & Ocular Oncology Surgeon, Lucknow, India

> Dr. Saumika Singh is a fellowship-trained oculoplasty, orbit and ocular oncology
> surgeon practising at Alyantra Medicity Superspeciality Hospital, Lucknow, Uttar
> Pradesh, India. She holds MBBS, MS (Ophthalmology) and FICO (Fellow of the Royal
> College of Ophthalmologists, UK) qualifications and is registered with the Uttar
> Pradesh Medical Council (Reg. No. 137106). This bilingual website (English + Hindi)
> covers her clinical services, peer-reviewed publications, and consented surgical
> case studies.

## About

- [Surgeon profile — Dr. Saumika Singh](https://drsaumika.in/about): Qualifications (MBBS, MS Ophthalmology, FICO UK), training history, research publications, and clinical philosophy. Fellowship-trained in oculoplasty and ocular oncology.

## Clinical Services

- [Eyelid disorders & eyelid surgery](https://drsaumika.in/services/eyelid-disorders-eyelid-surgery): Ptosis (drooping eyelid), entropion, ectropion, eyelid tumours, blepharoplasty, eyelid reconstruction.
- [Watering eyes & tear drainage disorders](https://drsaumika.in/services/watering-eyes-tear-drainage-disorders): Epiphora, blocked tear duct, dacryocystitis, DCR (dacryocystorhinostomy), canalicular repair.
- [Orbital disorders & orbital surgery](https://drsaumika.in/services/orbital-disorders-orbital-surgery): Thyroid eye disease (Graves' orbitopathy), orbital tumours, orbital fractures, orbital decompression.
- [Eye tumours & ocular oncology](https://drsaumika.in/services/eye-tumours-ocular-oncology): Ocular melanoma, retinoblastoma, sebaceous gland carcinoma, conjunctival
